landing.title: Build plans for the iSC Workflow web migration
landing.lede: iSC Workflow Web is the Next.js port of the iSarawak Care workflow portal — a multi-role government initiative + form-builder platform (admin CMS + public applicant portal) migrating off Flutter onto a typed, server-rendered web stack against the existing SOCOE backend. Each plan below is a sequence of disciplined TDD cycles, runnable across parallel sessions. Pick a plan to read its cycles and parallel runbook.
